//setupCommands: OPTIONAL (#48). Commands run inside the sandbox at startup, AFTER `install` and BEFORE
`forge git-setup`. Use for provisioning agent tooling (an MCP server, a CLI) — NOT project
deps (those belong in `install`). Each runs via `sh -c` (so `&&`/`||`/quoting work) with the
container env, including `.sandcastle/.env` vars at RUN time (the Dockerfile build does not
see those). End a command with `|| true` to make it best-effort; leave it bare to fail the
run. Survives `afk:update` (it's your config, not layer source). Rename to `setupCommands`
"setupCommands": ["npm i -g @scope/tool && claude mcp add --scope user tool -- tool-serve || true"]
//ui: OPTIONAL (#19). Omit this key entirely and nothing changes — non-UI repos are unaffected.
When present, a PR whose diff matches verifyGlobs MUST publish screenshots or the loop
refuses to merge it. The layer never renders: renderCmd is YOUR command and your
dockerBaseImage must contain whatever it needs (e.g. a browser). The agent pushes images
to artifactBranch (an orphan branch, never merged) under pr-<n>/.
verifyGlobs    globs that mark a PR UI-touching
renderCmd      writes images into artifactDir; capture desktop + narrow, dark + light
canonDir       optional canonical mockups to compare against

//ui-example.//: INERT sample — the `//` prefix makes this NOT the `ui` key, so the gate stays OFF. To enable, copy this into your afk.config.json as `ui` (no prefix) and point renderCmd at a real script. Shipping it armed would turn the gate ON for every consumer (the test suite seeds afk.config.json from this file) against a renderCmd that doesn't exist.
